none: PAS CAM-802758: Copper-alloy Nummus Roman Coin of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine. Trier, 333-334. Reece period 17. Obverse shows helmeted Constantine. Obverse legend reads CONSTANINOPOLIS. Reverse shows Victory on prow. Wreath/-//TRP. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight 1.76g, diameter 17.75mm. RIC VIII, p. 218, no.554
